messages:
Mina: quick heads-up 11 ran a targeted perf pass on the new canary (host proxy + tokenizer pool changes). p95 CPU for small requests rose ~10% when tokenization overlapped with many tiny gRPC writes. uploading artifacts.

ci-bot: perf artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/canaries/1767501234/snapshot.tar.gz :eye: 

Jonas: high-level take?

Mina: flame shows tokenize::byte_iter, parse::emit_chunk, and grpc::writev as hotspots. syscall sendmsg appears often; memcpy from parser to slab visible. kv-cache had short eviction bursts when cross-shard access hits. not heavy mutex contention, mostly many small syscalls + allocations.

Priya: any hypothesis on root cause?

Sam: likely small-write amplification from the proxy + HPACK/http2 framing. Options: coalesce writev in proxy or batch frames for a short delay (latency tradeoff). Also reduce allocator churn in tokenizer.

Ravi: compiler/kernel angle: our kernel selector prefers kernel_A for seq<64 which is cheaper in GPU cycles but triggers extra host copy/formatting. our cost model was trained on long seqs; needs biasing for short-seq steady-state.

Jonas: batching heuristics: most of these requests are effectively batch=1 across the stack so host overhead isn't amortized. consider adaptive min_batch/backpressure in the fronting layer.

Priya: careful about SLOs. increasing min_batch can hurt cold-start  and p50 latency. need canary + strict gates.

Mina: propose a 4x experiment matrix for canary:
A) proxy writev coalesce: threshold 256B or delay 2ms
B) tokenizer buffer pool: reuse fixed 64KB buffers to avoid per-request mallocs
C) kernel selector tweak: penalize kernel_A for seq_len<64 via host_syscall_penalty in cost formula
D) emit kv-cache shard telemetry (evictions, cross_shard_count)

Sam: +1. measure p50/p95/p99, cpu_sec_per_req, syscall_count, writes_size_histogram, small_write_ratio (writes<1KB).

Ravi: for (C) we can implement cost = host_parse_ms + kernel_est_ms + syscall_count * 0.1ms; tweak weight for seq<64. feature-flag it.

Jonas: will add small_write_ratio metric and dashboard panel.

Priya: owners and rollout? Need a rollback runbook if tails regress. Gate: rollback if p99 > 2% or cpu/sec/request > 10%.

Mina: I will own rollout and baseline collection. Sam owns proxy changes + unit tests. Ravi will prototype kernel cost tweak. Jonas adds dashboards.

ci-bot: created perf ticket INF-4825: "hostside small-write coalesce + tokenizer pool canary"; canary job redwood/canaries/host-opt-1767501234 created.

Mina: starting canary in ~20m, will post 1h A/B summary.

Sam: implementation notes:
- proxy: writev aggregator with max_batch_bytes=8192 and max_delay_ms=2, flagged and togglable per-route
- tokenizer: fixed buffer pool (64KB), avoid small-alloc memcpy path for inputs <4KB
- telemetry: per-req syscall_count, writes_size_histogram, kvcache_evictions, kernel_choice tag

Ravi: add microbenchmark: 5k qps of 10-40 token requests to exercise kernel selector offline before canary.

Mina: ack. will post artifacts and runbook after first hour.

Jonas: thx 11 ping infra if you need more quota.

Priya: remember to document the safety gates and quick rollback steps in the runbook.

Mina: will do.
